revision: adaptive-smoke change based on8f87813, source and reports committed together
isolation: Headless GPU runs serial; no simultaneous game or compile. Warmup/startup/readback excluded from timestamps.
comparison_limit: Earlier baseline used16volume cap; current game allows64active+32retiring, so sustained smoke persistence differs. Forced-full current run isolates adaptive rendering with the same new bounds and lifetime budget.

game_stress.scope: 40 real explosions/s, radius6.5m damage140, four identical overhead views, native3840x2160 full graphics, 180warmup+900measured60Hz ticks. No HUD/audio/presentation. Dev build CPU observations are not release acceptance.

scaling.allocation: Shared 6.75 MiB smoke asset is primed before measurements; cold first-explosion upload is excluded.
scaling.baked_volume_counts: Expected from current source rule, not observed/read back. Up to64 active volumes; an additional32 may retire over0.30s. This probe uses at most64, so its static births do not enter retirement.

layout_notes.inside: All explosions share one centre; four cameras sit within the default 6.5m-radius smoke box. Larger --radius overrides may also contain cameras in other layouts.
layout_notes.overlap: All explosions share one centre; cameras outside default-radius volumes.
layout_notes.spread: Centres are 5m apart on a centred grid; cameras stay outside default-radius volumes.

scaling.reconstruction: native HDR output, no TAA or spatial upscaler
scaling.scope: GPU root-pass timestamps in static floor-only fixture using full Effects.explosion recipe and its local lights; excludes gameplay simulation, destruction, crowd, UI, startup, upload and image readback. Not gameplay FPS.
scaling.timing_aggregation: Per-pass values already sum all views. instrumented_root_pass_sum is root-scope work, not covered elapsed GPU time or FPS.
